title: Fast Inference of Mixture-of-Experts Language Models with Offloading
technique: MoE-specific expert offloading with LRU expert cache and speculative expert pre-loading from previous-layer hidden states, plus mixed HQQ quantization (2/3-bit experts, 4-bit shared)

optimized_metrics.evidence: we focus on the task of generating tokens interactively, i.e. generate multiple tokens per second at batch size 1
we study the problem of running large MoE language models on consumer hardware with limited accelerator memory.
Our objective for this section is to find the best trade off between size and performance for offloading with the target setups.

headline_claim.text: develop a practical combination of mixed quantization and the proposed offloading algorithm to run this model interactively at 2-3 tokens per second depending on the hardware.
